name: SafeClick
description: Real-time, explainable phishing and malicious-URL detection. Know why a site is flagged — never a black-box verdict.

_comment_permissions.activeTab: Required to read the URL of the currently active tab when the popup is opened.
_comment_permissions.storage: Required for chrome.storage.local (settings persistence) and chrome.storage.session (ephemeral tab verdicts surviving service worker restarts).
_comment_permissions.scripting: Required to programmatically inject the content script if declarative injection fails (defensive fallback).
_comment_permissions.tabs: Required to listen to chrome.tabs.onActivated and onUpdated for URL change detection.
_comment_permissions.host_permissions_localhost: Scoped narrowly to localhost:8000 only — the Phase 2 backend reputation service. Does NOT request <all_urls> host permissions. Will be expanded in Phase 5 to the production API URL only.
